Ready for the maintainer to merge. CLEAN, with a pre-existing build failure tracked in #3952.

Safety-tier review. I read the whole diff and the current laws from upstream/main.

What looks good:

- The restart uses the existing plunge-height descent and its plunge guard.
- Short feeds keep a continuous path. Arcs, tool poses, and compensation spans have separate checks.
- The new tests detect both changes. The catalog regenerates to the recorded NC.

Pre-existing main failure, non-blocking:

The light build calls `cargo test --release -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --no-run`.
It fails in unchanged wire tests. Combined all-target clippy fails there too.
I ran both commands on bare main at the base SHA above. Both produced the same two errors:

```text
error[E0560]: struct `camcraft_app::operation::WireContourOp` has no field named `start`
  --> crates/app/tests/wire_dxf_selection/arcs.rs:49:9
error[E0560]: struct `camcraft_app::operation::WireContourOp` has no field named `start`
  --> crates/app/tests/wire_dxf_selection/arcs.rs:135:35
```

[Issue #3952](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/3952) tracks this main failure.
The product targets and the changed catalog suite pass the focused clippy commands above.

Mutations, run locally:

1. I restored the old restart plunge. `zigzag_plunge_restarts_feed_only_from_the_plunge_height` failed with a 13.5 mm plunge from Z20 to Z6.5. I restored the fix. The test passed.
2. I disabled `merge_short_feeds` at the ladder call. `catalog_3d_rough_finish::regenerates` failed because the regenerated NC differed. I restored the call. All six rough-finish tests passed.

Goldens checked:

- I read every changed NC line, including the changes inherited from #3880. The rapid endpoints rise by 2 mm. Added feeds cross that extra clearance distance. Short feed blocks leave the pocket section. The finish sections stay unchanged.
- I checked every changed cache region. There are 77 raised rapid entries and 24 regions that merge short feeds. All region boundaries and the full move chain remain continuous. The two operation stamps also change.
- I captured the rotary fixture moves on base and trial code. I compared every changed move behind `GOLDEN_RINGS`. One entry changes from 25 moves to 49 moves. Its rapid ends 2 mm higher in the radial direction. Its longer helix reaches the same final point. All other moves stay unchanged. Both digest tests passed with their respective pins.
- I removed the temporary trace code and restored the exact reviewed source. The final rotary digest test passed again.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes:

- The PR body says this change is stacked on #3880. Keep that merge order.
- No UI or process file changes. No screenshots are required for this diff.
- Full heavy lanes did not run. Current main requires the light lane for this P7 change.
- No machine run. The review used local tests and the recorded programs.
- The worktree and `review-3951` branch remain in place. No source or evidence changes remain in the tree.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

left for the maintainer: contour/3D Pocket ladder and posted G-code changes (`examples/catalog/3d/rough-finish`, `ladder.rs`); safety-tier. The counted marker pr-reviewer is by the author (mkinney), which does not count. Also #3952 tracks a separate main failure (wire_dxf_selection uses the removed `start` field); that issue gates the app build. The maintainer approves and merges by hand.
